letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. As the calendar flips to a new day—just another page in our story that began on a sun‑kissed February—my heart still skips when I see your smile. Thank you for turning ordinary moments into golden memories; you are my compass, my laughter, my home. I love you more than words can capture, today and always.
poem:
In desert dunes or riverside glow,  
Your love is the rhythm that makes me flow.  
Through spice‑scented nights and sunrise hue,  
My heart beats only for you.
